properties.name: Terra Sinica
properties.principle: East Asia to its continental margin: China east of the Indus–Yarlung suture with Tibet (ZR21), Mongolia and Transbaikalia, the Amur and Manchuria, Korea, Japan, Sakhalin and the Kurils, and the Yellow, East China and Japan seas, ending at the Siberian craton's rim, the Sea of Okhotsk's median and the Red River fault (ZR22).
